lines.text: Rosa: "I've heard good things about Emberhold. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"Walk with me? I want another pair of eyes on something."
"All right. Let's ask them."
"All right — let's ask them." You carry the proposal to Emberhold.
"Oh — okay. Later, then."
(Mutlaq speaks only 🇸🇦 Arabic. No shared words at all — just eyes, hands, and patience.)

"Can I ask you something else?"
"Yeah? What's up? I mean it."
"Sure. I'll be around."
They nod, already turning away.
